items.title: Plas Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: Jerry is not a student of mine but he’s been a fan of mine for years, and we talk about pieces

ctx.x: A saxophonist by the name of Jerry Jumonville also was called in and Jerry is not a student of mine but he’s been a fan of mine for years, and we talk about pieces and he likes my style, and so actually when I heard the solo I really thought it was me, but I don’t think so because I’ve seen on Jerry’s record he put that he played it so it just might be his solo.
Well if it’s not you it’s somebody trying to be you.
